description: Intent i017 (loop-parser-stale-state, snapshot s05) complete. One finding: net/mpls/af_mpls.c mpls_multipath_hash() lines 167-216 — hdr captured at line 174 (hdr = mpls_hdr(skb) + label_index;) inside the label-stack parse loop, interior pskb_may_pull() calls at lines 199 and 208-209 may reallocate skb->head, and the stale hdr is reused to derive v4hdr = (const struct iphdr *)(hdr + 1) at line 202 and v6hdr at line 212 with full dereferences (version, saddr/daddr/protocol, nexthdr) for the multipath hash — the pep_get_sb() loop-parser stale-state shape with untrusted MPLS label-stack length driving the pull; read-only (hash input), medium confidence, no runtime reproducer. Baseline: the seed itself remains unpatched in s05 at net/phonet/pep.c pep_get_sb() line 56 (ph live across pskb_may_pull(skb, ph->sb_len), then ph->sb_len -= 2 write). Twelve other candidates classified: x25_parse_facilities, ipv6_skip_exthdr/ipv6_find_hdr, ip6_tnl_parse_tlv_enc_lim, tcf_csum_ipv6, decode_session6, ipv6_gso_pull_exthdrs, ip_vs_in_icmp, batman-adv routing handlers, OVS parse_vlan_tag, ipv6_srh_rcv all safe (pulls followed by refetch or no pull at all); batadv_nc_code_packets safe-with-doubt; l2tp_recv_core unresolved. Artifact written to agent-state/findings/i017.json.
